title: Case Study Analysis
description: Analyze a real-world case, identify the core problem, and recommend a course of action.
instructions:
Choose (or use the assigned) case study and write a structured analysis:

  1. Summary — the situation in your own words, in one paragraph.
  2. Problem identification — what is the core problem? Distinguish causes from symptoms.
  3. Analysis — apply at least two concepts or frameworks from the course. Show your reasoning.
  4. Recommendation — what should be done, by whom, and why? Address at least one likely objection.

Aim for 1,000–1,500 words. Cite any sources you use.
grading_guidelines:
Strong submissions will:

  • Identify the real problem, not just restate the case (25%)
  • Apply course concepts accurately and explicitly (35%)
  • Make a specific, defensible recommendation (25%)
  • Write clearly with sources cited (15%)
